title: One-step unfolding of a run
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, let $\text{oracle}$ be an oracle, let $x$ be an input bit string, let $b$ be a Boolean choice, let $\sigma$ be a finite choice string, and let $a$ be an initial configuration. Running on the string formed by placing $b$ before $\sigma$ is the same as first taking the step determined by $b$ and then running on $\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle and input bit string
